decision: How should the home page answer Randy Epp's question, 'What is my experience as a parent giving this to my kid?': a new section after How it works, or a line inside it, and in what shape?
source: Randy Epp review 2026-10-09 (vault: 60 Logs/Meetings/AI Workbooks/Oct 9 - Randy _ Savar). His top fix: parent involvement, weekly time, tips to introduce the books.
primary_axis: structure of the parent answer: calendar vs split ledger vs timeline vs questions vs inline
invariants: real home page, section sits right after How it works
same facts: 15-20 minutes a day, 5 days a week; the app is for the parent; scan when stuck; scan finished pages
draft copy: no parent-minute number, no starter guide in the box (we have neither)

options.name: Your week
options.bet: A week as three swim lanes (your child, you, us); on phones one row per day
options.benefit: Shows the routine and the size of the parent's part at a glance; answers 'days per week'
options.cost: Calendar cells hold 2-3 words, so tips go in a note under it
options.risk: Reads as a schedule we enforce; the Us lane looks empty

options.name: You vs us
options.bet: 'You coach. We do the rest.' Four parent steps beside a longer list of what we do
options.benefit: Shortest clear answer; the length difference is the argument
options.cost: No sense of time (first week vs later)
options.risk: 'We do the rest' can sound like a promise to do more than we do

options.name: First month
options.bet: Timeline from Day 1 to the end of the first book, beside the family photo
options.benefit: Answers Randy's 'more than that, at least at first' directly; tips live in the steps
options.risk: Uses the step 5 photo a second time on desktop

options.name: Parent questions
options.bet: Four questions a parent asks, in large type, answered in two sentences
options.benefit: Matches how parents think; covers 'do I need to teach it' and 'what if they don't want to'
options.risk: Two FAQ-like blocks on one page

options.name: Inside How it works
options.bet: No new section: each step card gets a 'Your part' line
options.benefit: Shortest page (+0.6 screens on phones); the parent's part sits next to each step
options.cost: No place for tips or the first-week point beyond one line
options.risk: Randy saw step 3 ('15-20 minutes a day') and still missed the parent's role; scattered lines may fail the same way
